text: Ordered a hot latte to start work from home; it reached me cold at 9:40. The rider kept circling the wrong block.
My order arrived sideways - foam pooled in the lid and the pastry sat in a puddle of spilled coffee. Morning ruined.
They sent a matcha instead of my filter coffee and it took an hour. First work call of the day, no caffeine.
Strawberry shake had gone warm and separated by the time it arrived. The cup was sweating through the paper bag.
Order ek ghante baad aaya aur sab kuch thanda tha. Subah 8 baje ka mood bigad diya.
Eleven-item morning order for the team - three drinks missing, two wrongly labelled. I had to re-check every cup myself.
Team breakfast promised by 9 arrived at 10:20, everything lukewarm. Never ordering the morning run again.
Stood in a six-person queue for twelve minutes at 8:10 and the espresso still came out wrong. My bus left without me.
Bhaiya jaldi karo bola phir bhi 15 min laga. Cappuccino bhi jala hua. Roz ka nahi ho sakta ye.
Wonderful - the office coffee arrived after my standup ended. Cold brew, no orange twist, oddly bitter. Exactly what I needed.
Quiet morning, three people behind the counter, and still a 20-minute wait for one cup. Nobody acknowledged the queue.
My usual tasted burnt and watered-down at once today. At these prices this regular is reconsidering the habit.
Six months of the same order and today the espresso was sour. When I said so, the counter rolled its eyes. Noted.
Prices badh gaye subah ke order ke aur quantity bhi kam. Upar se 15 min wait. Budget cry.
Kids' breakfast order came with one hot chocolate instead of two and the waffle was ice cold. Tears before school, thanks.
Cold brew and muffin landed 45 minutes late; the muffin was fine but coffee this late defeats the purpose.
The cup lid was loose and a third of my latte was sloshing in the bag. What survived tasted decent, sadly.
Asked for the paneer tikka sandwich, got the chilli cheese toast instead. Not bad, just not the breakfast I ordered.
Filter coffee thandi aayi aur 40 min late. Subah ki pehli cup aisi nahi honi chahiye.
Cheesecake slice arrived tipped over and smeared inside the box. Flavour was lovely under the mess.
Eight cappuccinos for the 9am huddle: six arrived, two turned out to be lattes. Labels lied, meeting survived.
Bulk chai run reached forty minutes late and one cup had leaked into the carrier. Half the team gave up.
One till open at 8:15 and the card reader blinking out. Watched two regulars walk out ahead of me.
Lid theek se nahi laga tha, aadha drink shirt pe aa gaya. Office meeting mein coffee stain leke gaya.
Flat white is a notch weaker this week and the price board has quietly moved up. Loyalty doing heavy lifting here.
Sat at my usual corner; table was sticky and the croissant felt yesterday-old. Off morning for a place I rate.
Subah aaye the padhne, par counter pe awaaz bahut thi aur order 18 min mein aaya. Drink acchi thi bas.
Cheese toast reached the hostel cold and chewy. For 260 plus delivery fees, expected way better.
Empty cafe at 9, kids hungry, and our pasta and shake took 35 minutes. Staff apologised but the damage was done.
Bachon ka hot chocolate garam nahi tha aur fries ki jagah muffin aa gaya. Mix-up se breakfast kharab.
Walked in for the famous filter coffee on a calm Tuesday; got a watery, barely-warm tumbler after 15 minutes.
Camped here 9 to noon; wifi steady, table quiet. Chair wobbled and the music got louder around 11.
Good quiet corner to work through the morning. Only gripe: the drink prices stretch a laptop camper's budget.
Drink smooth tha aur morning bilkul shaant. Bas plug point nahi mila pehle ek ghante.
Same cappuccino, same heart pour - but the cup price crept up again this month. Consistency good, wallet sad.
New face at the till fumbled my usual order and the wait doubled. Once the cup arrived, all was forgiven.
Espresso pulled nicely but the queue moved slow even on a quiet Wednesday. Ten minutes door to cup.
Chai sasti aur acchi, seat bhi mili subah. Lekin table saaf nahi tha aur wifi slow.
Peaceful mid-morning with a rose latte and a book. Lovely, though the pastry fridge hums louder than it should.
Waffle was crisp and the kids loved it; just wish the kitchen hadn't taken 25 minutes on a near-empty morning.
Charming pink nook for a quiet breakfast. Kulhad chai was fragrant; the counter forgot my sugar though.
Cappuccino jaldi mila, bas bag mein thoda leak hua. Overall theek thaak for a rush morning.
In and out in six minutes with a solid flat white. Cup sleeve missing though - burned fingers on the walk.
Picked up nine drinks at 8:30; all present, two labels swapped. Counter was apologetic and quick to fix.
Espresso decent as ever; but the shot feels smaller and the price edged up. Penny-pinching feel lately.
Cappuccino arrived warm-not-hot in 30 minutes. Drinkable, decent foam - just misses the cafe-fresh mark.
Croissant thoda soft ho gaya tha bag mein, par taste fresh tha. Packing thodi careful ho toh perfect.
Morning bulk order landed on time; one chai missing its label and one sandwich swapped. Mostly smooth.
Kids' fries and pasta arrived slightly cooled. Portions generous though; a quick reheat fixed it.
Cheesecake delivered intact, glaze pretty, edges a touch dry. Fine for a quiet Tuesday treat.
Desk coffee reached inside the slot; flat white had flattened to a latte in transit. Still better than office vending.
Rider was quick but the hot chocolate arrived merely warm. Marshmallows had melted into the lid.
Iced latte arrived upright, ice half-melted, diluting the drink. Fine for a home morning, not great.
Fries thande the par peri-peri masala bachaya order ko. 160 ka thoda mehenga laga, v late bhi.
Team ke liye 12 items mangaye - sab aaye, bas ek-do labels ulti. Aur chai raste mein thandi ho gayi.
Three hours of quiet work, two cold brews, nobody hovering for the table. Music could be a notch softer.
Weekday 9am is the sweet spot - every table free, plug near the window, refills without fuss.
Cold brew with that orange twist plus near-silent mornings equals my favourite desk away from home.
Got the corner seat, wifi held through two calls, refills landed fast. Crowd builds post-10 though.
Kabir pulled my usual without me ordering - medium flat white, extra hot. That is why I keep coming back.
Meera remembered I switched to oat milk last week. The pour was silky; the morning felt looked-after.
Same honest filter coffee at 120 - frothy, strong, fair. Only reason it's not five stars is the creeping pastry prices.
Weekday breakfast ritual: croissant still warm from the 6am bake, quiet room, pink walls. Dependable.
Subah 8 baje full khali cafe, chai 140 aur seat apni pasand ki. Padhai ke liye perfect.
Cheese toast mast tha, cheese properly melt. Price thoda zyada par morning mein worth it.
Early slot means actual seats and breakfast that doesn't hurt the wallet. Plugs work, mostly.
Slow weekday breakfast - rose latte, warm cinnamon roll, sunlight through the pink window. Gentle start.
Quiet counter, patient barista walked me through the matcha. Whisked fresh, grassy and smooth.
Nearly empty at 10 on a Thursday; avocado toast plated prettily and nobody rushed us. Blissful.
Brought the kids before school; the team warmed the muffin and kept the hot chocolate kid-temperature. Thoughtful.
Waffle and fries kept two small kids happy on a weekday morning. A little slow, very tasty.
Found this pink gem on a morning walk through Indiranagar. Filter coffee in a dabarah - proper local touch.
Roz subah ka flat white - aaj bhi 5 min mein ready. Consistent hai, bas sleeve kabhi kabhi nahi milta.
Four minutes from door to espresso at 8 sharp. The morning crew runs like a metronome.
Grabbed a cappuccino and croissant on the way to the metro; hot, quick, correctly priced. No complaints.
Kabir had my ticket up before I finished paying. Two-minute turnaround on my usual, every single weekday.
Picked up a dozen labelled drinks at 8:40 - all correct, carrier bags sturdy. One cup short a sleeve.
Morning cappuccino landed hot within the promised window. The kraft bag was crisp, cup upright. Reliable.
Waffle and shake reached in good shape - shake still thick, waffle warm. Delivery mornings done right.
Cold brew and muffin for a home-office morning: sealed tight, chilled, tasted like the counter version.
Was home with a cold; my usual flat white arrived hot and on time. Even delivered, it tastes like mine.
Chai aur fries hostel pe aaye time pe, garam bhi. Paisa vasool for a lazy morning.
Ordered croissants to the hotel before checkout; arrived warm, flaking into the paper. Sweet goodbye to the city.
Hot chocolate still properly hot on arrival, marshmallows intact. Morning delivery that respects the drink.
Rose milk and croissant packed neatly, nothing spilled. Sabja seeds settled but a quick stir fixed it.
Cheesecake travelled beautifully - glaze glossy, crust intact. A weekday indulgence at home.
School-morning delivery: hot chocolate, waffle, fries - all on time and warm. Slightly less peri-peri than in-store.
Empty cafe at opening, plug at every second table, calm all around. Three productive hours before the crowd.
Quiet Tuesday, lo-fi on the speaker, wifi rock solid through a long client call. My unofficial office.
Two refills over three hours and zero pressure to leave. The morning calm here is unbeatable.
Subah 9 se 12 tak kaam kiya - bilkul shaant, wifi fast, cold brew ekdum fresh. Best wfh alternative.
The crew let me camp through the slow hours and even refilled water without asking. Laptop-friendly done right.
Zoya at the till greeted me by name and had the usual rung up before I reached the counter. Home, basically.
Two years, same cappuccino, same heart on top. Whatever they pay the morning barista, it is not enough.
My 8:30 table by the window was free as always. Newspaper, quiet room, dependable cup. This cafe runs my mornings.
Espresso at 140 is still the best-value shot in the neighbourhood. Pulled clean, every weekday, no fuss.
Dev spotted me through the kitchen door and sent the croissant out warm without being asked. Small things, big loyalty.
Consistency is the whole review: same order, same smile, same corner. Five stars, as always.
Subah ka sasta cup, free seat, shaant mahaul - student paradise morning mein. Roz aaunga.
Fries aur cheese toast dono fresh nikle subah hi. 420 mein pet bhar gaya, pocket bhi khush.
Cheapest decent morning in Indiranagar - filter coffee, a shared muffin, and nobody eyeing our table.
Weekday mid-morning perfection: rose latte art, warm croissant, and a whole quiet room to ourselves.
Matcha whisked to order, cheesecake fresh from the fridge, and soft light on pink walls. Heaven on a weekday.
Early breakfast before school run - patient staff, quick warm cups for the kids, and a clean corner table.
Detoured off the main road and found the cutest pink cafe. The local brew was the real deal, staff sweet.
First morning in Bengaluru and this place set the bar - warm hospitality and a breakfast worth remembering.
Rare morning with ten minutes to spare, so I sat in. Espresso was flawless and the room was calm.
Daily 8:15 stop - cappuccino hamesha ready, taste kabhi change nahi. Metro se pehle perfect.
Meera starts my usual the second she sees me cross the road. Ninety seconds, door to platform.
Usual morning grab: cappuccino in four minutes flat, sleeve on, lid sealed, day started right.
Cappuccino arrived still steaming in a snug kraft bag. Morning delivery at its most dependable.
Ordered the moment they opened; waffle and cold brew at my door in 25 minutes, both perfect.
Filter coffee garam aaya, dabarah wali feel bhi. Subah ka best start, seedha ghar pe.
Flu kept me home but not from my flat white. Arrived hot in 20 minutes - tasted exactly like the counter.
Slow morning in: cheesecake slice delivered pristine, glaze shining, box chilled. Restaurant-quality at home.
Warm delivery came wrapped tight, toppings still intact. The kids' school morning was saved.
Breakfast delivered by 8:45, chilled and neat. This cafe never fumbles an order.
Chai garam aur kadak aayi, packing solid. Subah ka scene sorted.
Hostel breakfast - crispy, melty, budget friendly aur fast. Roz yehi chahiye.
Fourteen-item team breakfast, every label right, delivered inside the window. Admin life made easy.
